supported_runtime_cases.existing: Validate a stopped Phase-1 controller PID/PGID and the already loaded guards, then send SIGCONT only with --execute.
supported_runtime_cases.replacement: On a rebooted instance with no controller and no partial seed-43 I8 state, stage the controller as a stopped session leader, bind newly deployed transient guards to its PGID, then send SIGCONT only after all guard checks pass.

required_runtime_preconditions: The seed-42 selection artifact still advances I8.
The seed-43 I0 postverify artifact is verified and every bound artifact still matches its SHA-256.
No evaluator or vLLM EngineCore is running.
No seed-44 artifact and no seed-43 comparison already exists.
Existing mode requires the exact controller to be a stopped process-group leader with the expected working directory and active guards.
Replacement mode requires no controller, a free controller lock, no partial seed-43 I8 state, and no stale transient guards.

storage_capacity_gate.reason: Two measured seed-43 checkpoints require approximately 15.431 GB before evaluation records, logs, and runtime margin.
storage_capacity_gate.projection_warning: The projection is only 55,778,048 bytes above the gate and excludes the remaining evaluation output growth, so step-25 removal alone is not assumed sufficient.

guard_contract.i8_summary: Trigger the I8 postverify script with method I8.
guard_contract.seed43_comparison: Stop the entire controller process group before the original controller can proceed to seed 44.
guard_contract.replacement_staging: The replacement controller stops itself before executing the controller script; guard deployment precedes SIGCONT.

replacement_mode_disclosure: The original controller begins at its deterministic seed-42 verification section. Completed training and evaluation runs are verified and skipped, while seed-42 paired-comparison and selection artifacts are atomically regenerated before seed-43 I0 is verified and skipped. Their bound implementation hashes must match before launch.
